exposure: Type of surgical treatment for initial RPOC (suction curettage vs. hysteroscopy)
Context of initial RPOC (after delivery vs. after abortion)
outcome: Third stage of labor placental problems (retained placenta, cotyledons, placenta accreta)
cohort: The study included 442 women who were surgically treated for retained products of conception (RPOC) following delivery or abortion.
finding: Women treated for initial RPOC, particularly those managed by suction curettage or whose initial RPOC occurred after delivery, are at a significantly increased risk for recurrent RPOC and third stage of labor placental problems in subsequent pregnancies.
